ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_CI_Trust_Retail]
AS
BEGIN



DROP TABLE  DW.CI_Trust_Retail;

WITH DimCustomerAccount_TRU
AS(
    SELECT AccountID,AccountSK,CustomerID,CustomerSK,BranchSK,DCA.SourceSystemCode,DCA.ValidStartDate,DCA.BankSK
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA
    WHERE DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'TRU' AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = '1'
)


SELECT
    DCA.AccountID
    ,DCA.CustomerID
    ,CASE WHEN DC.GlobalCIF IS NOT NULL THEN REPLACE(DC.GlobalCIF,'Global_CIF_','Entity_CIF_')
      ELSE CONCAT('Entity_CIF_', DC.SourceSystemCode, '_', DC.CustomerID) END AS EntityCIF
    ,DB.BankID AS Bank_Code
    ,DBCH.BranchID AS Branch_Code
    ,DBCH.BranchName
    ,DBCH.Area
    ,DBCH.Region
    ,DCA.SourceSystemCode AS Source
    ,DP.ProductGroup AS ProductGrouping
    ,DP.ProductName AS ProductType
    ,CONCAT(DP.ProductGroup,'-',DP.ProductName) AS ProductDetails
    ,DA.AccountOpenedDate AS OpenedDate
    ,DFTFV.AUMAmountFull AS AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Full
    ,DFTFV.AUMAmountProrated AS AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Prorated
    ,DFTFV.BusinessDateSK AS BusinessDate
    ,DCA.ValidStartDate AS LastUpdatedDate
    ,CONCAT(DCA.AccountId,DCA.CustomerID,DB.BankID,DCA.SourceSystemCode) as AccountKey    
    INTO DW.CI_Trust_Retail
FROM DimCustomerAccount_TRU DCA
JOIN (SELECT CustomerSK ,GlobalCIF,SourceSystemCode,CustomerID FROM DW.DimCustomer WHERE CustomerType = 'Retail') DC ON DCA.CustomerSK = DC.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BranchSK,BranchID,BranchName,Area,Region FROM DW.DimBranch) DBCH ON DCA.BranchSK = DBCH.BranchSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BankSK ,BankID FROM DW.DimBank) DB ON DCA.BankSK = DB.BankSK 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,ProductSK FROM DW.DimAccountProduct) DAP ON DCA.AccountSK = DAP.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductSK,ProductGroup,ProductName FROM DW.DimProduct) DP ON DAP.ProductSK = DP.ProductSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountOpenedDate,AccountSK FROM DW.DimAccount) DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,AUMAmountFull,AUMAmountProrated,BusinessDateSK FROM DW.FactTrustFundValue WHERE BusinessDateSK = (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactTrustFundValue )) DFTFV ON DCA.AccountSK = DFTFV.AccountSK
GROUP BY
DCA.AccountID
,DCA.CustomerID
,DC.GlobalCIF
,DC.SourceSystemCode
,DC.CustomerID
,DB.BankID
,DBCH.BranchID
,DBCH.BranchName
,DBCH.Area
,DBCH.Region
,DCA.SourceSystemCode
,DP.ProductGroup
,DP.ProductName
,DA.AccountOpenedDate
,DFTFV.AUMAmountFull
,DFTFV.AUMAmountProrated
,DFTFV.BusinessDateSK
,DCA.ValidStartDate

END
